name: DentaQuestD3320D2950D2740PALogic
title: DentaQuest D3320 / D2950 / D2740 Prior Authorization Determination Logic
description: SYNTHETIC DentaQuest policy authored for the connectathon (owner-approved). Rule: a prior authorization is required when a Texas Medicaid Adult/Child Dental order contains root canal therapy (D3320), a core build-up (D2950) or a full-coverage porcelain/ceramic crown (D2740) on the same tooth as one bundled treatment plan, and the authorization is decided as one request with one result per service line. Documentation required: clinical notes documenting medical necessity and radiographs. The Library content is a STUB (the CQL header only), exactly like the D7210 library: the rule is applied by the test server's CRD service, not by executing CQL.
